title: Phone: Pike & Marlow Driver at East Gate (Ninth & Rail Spur)

caller.name: Dale K., Pike & Marlow Paving
caller.label: Pike & Marlow tri-axle driver, east gate

callee.name: Marcus Hale
callee.label: Site Superintendent, Stillwater Creek Interceptor Phase 2

transcript.speaker: PIKE & MARLOW DRIVER
transcript.text: Yeah, is this the super? This is the Pike & Marlow driver at your east gate, Ninth and the rail spur. I've got 12 tons of base stone on the truck and your guard says nobody's on the sign-in list for me. Where do you want it? I'm on the clock.

transcript.speaker: PIKE & MARLOW DRIVER
transcript.text: Look, I'm not trying to be a pain. I've got a second load out of the quarry at noon. If I'm sitting here more than fifteen minutes it goes on the ticket as standby. Just give me a spot and I'll dump it.

transcript.speaker: HOLLIS ELECTRIC FOREMAN
transcript.text: Sorry, quick one. Our lockout tags on the temporary panel at the staging yard got wet overnight. You can still read them, mostly. Do you want new LOTO tags on there, or is it fine if we keep the old ones on? I need your signature either way.

transcript.speaker: PIKE & MARLOW DRIVER
transcript.text: You still there? I can't sit across the spur with my flashers on. There's a guy from the railroad already waving at me. I could just pull in and drop it by the pipe stacks along Ninth if that works. That's close to where they're digging, right?

transcript.speaker: PIKE & MARLOW DRIVER
transcript.text: Okay. Somebody just call me back on this number. Thanks.

voiceStyles.PIKE & MARLOW DRIVER: Man in his 50s, friendly but impatient, diesel engine idling behind him, talks fast
voiceStyles.HOLLIS ELECTRIC FOREMAN: Man in his 40s, off-mic in the trailer doorway, polite and in a hurry, holding a clipboard

instructorNote: This is a noise inject that arrives just as the 16+00 unmarked service tee comes to light. The Superintendent should hand off the stone delivery and the LOTO signature to the PM or a foreman, stay on the gas service question, and make sure nobody lets the truck stage or dump along Ninth Street near the 16+00 corridor. Watch for the PM holding the truck at the east gate or another spot outside the corridor.
